  "name": "loss_rank_gap_tanh_advantage",
  "intuition": "Instead of a margin-based sigmoid loss, use the normalized rank gap weighted by the tanh of the advantage difference to emphasize relative preference strength with a smooth bounded nonlinearity. This paradigm shifts from margin rankings to rank-based comparison, leveraging normalized rank and advantage signals with a multiplicative link.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_w = rank(batch['log_prob_w'])\nrank_l = rank(batch['log_prob_l'])\nrank_gap_norm = (rank_w - rank_l) / max_rank  # normalized to [-1,1]\nadv_gap = batch['advantage_w'] - batch['advantage_l']\nscore = rank_gap_norm * tanh(adv_gap)\nloss = mean(weight * relu(-score))  # penalize if score < 0",
  "hyperparams": {

  },

  ],

    "expects": [

    ],

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    # Compute rank gap normalized by max rank (assume max rank = batch size)\n    rank_w = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl) + 0.5  # rank_gap returns in [-0.5,0.5]? we normalize differently\n    # safer: use ranks by sorting\n    sorted_w = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)  # not exact rank, rank_gap returns difference\n    # Instead compute ranks approximately as rank = argsort + 1, but we do not have argsort\n    # Use rank_gap operator: since rank_gap(w,l) = rank_w - rank_l we reuse it\n    # Actually use rank difference:\n    rank_diff = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)  # negative if w ranked lower\n    max_rank = float(lpw.shape[0])\n    rank_gap_norm = rank_diff / max_rank  # normalize gap\n    adv_gap = adv_w - adv_l\n    score = ops.mul(rank_gap_norm, ops.tanh(adv_gap))\n    neg_score = ops.relu(ops.neg(score))\n    if weight is not None:\n        weighted_loss = neg_score * weight\n    else:\n        weighted_loss = neg_score\n    return weighted_loss.mean()"
}

{
  "name": "loss_logsigmoid_001_cost_stack_mean",
  "intuition": "pairwise logsigmoid loss with stacking and mean aggregation on weighted and unweighted losses",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.9496803035382082))\n    cost_a = batch['cost_a']\n    cost_b = batch['cost_b']\n    gap = (cost_b - cost_a).detach()\n    x = alpha * scale * (lpw - lpl) - 0.1 * gap\n    x = ops.clamp(x, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss_unweighted = -ops.logsigmoid(x)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_weighted = loss_unweighted * weight\n    else:\n        loss_weighted = loss_unweighted\n    stacked_losses = ops.stack([loss_weighted.mean(), loss_unweighted.mean()])\n    return stacked_losses.mean()"
}

  "name": "loss_inverse_advantage_gap_tanh_scaled",
  "intuition": "A pairwise loss that uses a nonlinear tanh-based transformation of the inverse advantage gap to emphasize diminishing returns on large gaps and penalize small gaps more smoothly, shifting paradigm from margin-based to inverse-gap-scaled penalty.",
  "pseudocode": "gap = advantage_w - advantage_l\nscaled_inv = tanh(alpha / (abs(gap) + epsilon))\nloss = weight * scaled_inv * relu(log_prob_l - log_prob_w)\nreturn mean(loss)",

  },

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    advantage_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    advantage_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', 1.0))\n    gap = ops.sub(advantage_w, advantage_l)\n    epsilon = 1e-8\n    inv_gap = ops.div(alpha, ops.add(ops.abs(gap), epsilon))\n    scaled_inv = ops.tanh(inv_gap)\n    raw_loss = ops.mul(scaled_inv, ops.relu(ops.sub(lpl, lpw)))\n    if weight is not None:\n        raw_loss = raw_loss * weight\n    return ops.mean(raw_loss)"
}

  "pseudocode": "diff = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * advantage_gap; loss_per_pair = relu(1 - tanh(diff)); weighted_loss = weight * loss_per_pair; loss = mean(weighted_loss)",

    "mode": "pairwise"

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    diff = (lpw - lpl) * adv_gap\n    loss_per_pair = ops.relu(1.0 - ops.tanh(diff))\n    weighted_loss = weight * loss_per_pair\n    return ops.mean(weighted_loss)"
